documented: POST /api/chat/preview targets published Agent version on channel web
PATCH /api/chat/conversations/{id} updates metadata, DELETE deletes permanently

Follow-up request reuses conversation_id in JSON payload
API Key is held securely on backend/server side, never leaked to client bundle
